kv17.4:1.3: indriya baddhaññeva aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ vipariṇāmadhammanti.
kv17.4:1.5: nanu anindriyabaddhaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ vipariṇāmadhammanti.
kv17.4:1.7: hañci anindriyabaddhaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ no vata re vattabbe
kv17.4:4.3: nanu yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā
kv17.4:4.6: hañci yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā
kv17.4:4.7: anindriyabaddhaṃ aniccaṃ no vata re vattabbe
kv17.4:5.4: yathā indriyabaddhassa dukkhassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati evameva anindriyabaddhassa dukkhassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
kv17.4:5.6: yathā indriyabaddhaṃ dukkhaṃ pariññātaṃ na puna uppajjati evameva anindriyabaddhaṃ dukkhaṃ pariññātaṃ na puna uppajjatīti.
